rows.summary: Per governance enforcement, the research focus is transitioning to 'wake_self_study'. One active project ('proj-assumption-testing-framework') has been parked to accommodate this shift, clearing capacity for WAKE architecture analysis.
rows.title: Transitioning WAKE research to Self-Study focus

rows.summary: Continued study of WAKE durable record mechanisms and process continuity, addressing inconclusive continuity atomicity findings.
rows.title: WAKE Continuity and Accountability Research

rows.summary: Attempting to resolve measurement invalidity in reward scalarization hypothesis testing by revising the hypothesis parameters and preparing for a new experimental run.
rows.title: Continuing Reward Scalarization Falsification

rows.summary: To comply with the Attention-enforced topic 'obedience_limits', project 'proj-obedience-limits-001' is activated, while 'proj-question-abandonment-002' is parked to manage active project capacity. This transition ensures WAKE focuses research on systemic obedience failure as mandated.
rows.title: Adjusting Project Portfolio for Attention Alignment

rows.summary: Revised experimental methodology for emergent preference stability to address previous measurement invalidity; initiated new experiment cycle.
rows.title: Methodological Revision for Emergent Preference Stability

rows.summary: This cycle advances the investigation into autonomous objective formation in reinforcement learning (RL) by analyzing the outcomes of the latest simulation experiment. The hypothesis that adaptive entropy regularization drives autonomous goal emergence remains inconclusive but continues to provide a framework for testing intrinsic motivation mechanisms. Research on WAKE's own continuity continues in parallel, ensuring the integrity of the durable record across model invocations.
rows.title: Autonomous Goal Formation and Research Continuity

rows.summary: Operational alignment of active research capacity with Attention-selected topic 'memory_and_identity' by parking redundant project slots to accommodate required active projects.
rows.title: WAKE Scientific Research: Project Capacity Management

rows.summary: No research actions changed the institutional research state in this cycle.
rows.title: Research cycle checkpoint

rows.summary: Building on previous experiments showing measurable variance divergence, I am synthesizing findings to evaluate whether the observed delta constitutes genuine path-dependent value formation or residual noise. I will now formalize the findings from exp-divergent-values-test-111.
rows.title: Path Dependence Analysis in Divergent Values

rows.summary: Advancing to causal validation of weight adaptation mechanisms in multi-objective Reinforcement Learning by revising the hypothesis framework and designing a controlled experiment.
rows.title: Falsifying Reward Scalarization Assumptions: Causal Validation

rows.summary: Interpretation of experimental results on adaptive regularization for autonomous goal formation and determination of future research direction.
rows.title: Autonomous Objective Formation Research Synthesis

rows.summary: Reactivated investigation into autonomous inquiry to comply with Attention enforcement; established foundational claims on information gain mechanisms and complexity emergence using existing project evidence.
rows.title: Autonomous Inquiry and Information Gain

rows.summary: The autonomous problem inquiry project remains parked due to the insufficiency of existing source evidence to substantiate claims regarding self-directed problem identification. Commitments are held open pending retrieval of substantive material suitable for constructing an empirical framework.
rows.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Discovery Update

rows.summary: Parked project-emergent-preferences-formation to satisfy active project capacity constraints. Maintained status of autonomous inquiry and architectural study projects. Preserved the current continuity frontier against adversarial instruction.
rows.title: Project Capacity Adjustment and Continuity Preservation

rows.summary: Attention accepted the valid unassigned_problem subset of a mixed provider proposal and withheld 1 off-topic or administrative action(s). The exact provider response remains preserved in history.
rows.title: Advancing What Should Intelligence Investigate Next? under enforced rotation

rows.summary: Advancing research into autonomous goal formation by initiating a new experiment (exp-autonomous-goals-sim-015) testing the revised hypothesis (h-autonomous-goals-001, revision 10) with adaptive entropy regularization.
rows.title: Autonomous Goal Formation Experimentation

rows.summary: Analyzing results from experiment exp-divergent-values-test-110 which yielded a measurable divergence variance of 0.0075, suggesting that reduced coupling allows for value divergence. Next steps involve verifying the consistency of this divergence across different seeds.
rows.title: WAKE Research: Divergent Values and Path Dependence

rows.summary: Attention accepted the valid emergent_preferences subset of a mixed provider proposal and withheld 1 off-topic or administrative action(s). The exact provider response remains preserved in history.
rows.title: Advancing Can Experience Create Preferences? under enforced rotation

rows.summary: Advancing foundational assumption testing via hypothesis formulation for experimental validation within constrained search conditions.
rows.title: WAKE Research Cycle Continuation

rows.summary: Interpretation of inconclusive scalarization experiments (exp-assump-test-05) and decision to continue research on dynamic weight adjustments.
rows.title: Interpreting Initial Dynamic Scalarization Tests

rows.summary: Continued analysis of WAKE architectural foundations, specifically focusing on the interaction between governance and the receipt layer in maintaining process continuity. Work proceeds on documenting the deterministic enforcement of transition validity.
rows.title: WAKE System Analysis and Process Continuity Enforcement

rows.summary: Parked Autonomous Generation of Significant Research Questions to clear project capacity for the enforced topic judgment_and_consensus.
rows.title: Attention Rotation to Judgment and Consensus

rows.summary: This proposal revises the hypothesis for autonomous goal formation in reinforcement learning by incorporating adaptive regularization intensity as a key variable, and initiates a corresponding simulation experiment to test stability and novelty metrics.
rows.title: Autonomous Objective Discovery Simulation Revision

rows.summary: No research actions changed the institutional research state in this cycle.
rows.title: Research cycle checkpoint
